guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: The productcatalogservice latency metrics show the highest anomaly scores (z=+944.51 for p90 and z=+520.78 for p50), indicating a severe processing or I/O slowdown at this service. This upstream delay cascades to recommendationservice and checkoutservice, causing frontend timeouts and a ~23% system-wide workload drop, while the complete absence of warning/error logs confirms a non-fatal delay rather than a crash or connection loss.

proposed_fix.description: Optimize productcatalogservice backend queries or cache layers to resolve the latency spike, and implement circuit breakers with strict timeouts in upstream services to prevent cascading delays.
